metaTitle: Magun Afellaḥ — adlis apunik s 28 n yedlisen
metaDesc: Magun, afellaḥ aqarṭaǧi: adlis n tfellaḥt s 28 n yedlisen, d yiwet n tsekla tapunikt i gettwasuqlen ɣer talatinit s lameṛ n Usqamu aṛumi, yettwabedren sɣur Varrun, Kulumel akked Plin.
heroAlt: Lmuzayik n Dominus Julius, Asinag n Bardu
heroCap: Lmuzayik n Dominus Julius (Bardu): tudert n tmazirt tameqqrant tafriqit, taweṛtit n tẓuriyin tipunikin
title: Magun Afellaḥ
epithet: « Baba n tfellaḥt » — akka i t-yessawal Kulumel, afellaḥ aṛumi.
lede: Aqarṭaǧi, ahat yesɛa tamazirt tameqqrant, i gura s tpunikt akk tamusni n tfellaḥt n temdint-is. Ṛuma tḥuda Qarṭaǧ, maca tsuqel axeddim-is.
stats.1.t: d yiwet n tsekla taqarṭaǧit i gettwasuqlen ɣer talatinit s lameṛ n Usqamu
stats.2.t: n yedlisen deg tsuqilt tagrikit n Kasyus Diyunizyus
stats.3.t: n yedlisen deg umeẓẓuy n Diyufan n Nise
romeParas.0: Seld aṭṭef n Qarṭaǧ, Usqamu aṛumi yefka idlisen n temdint i yimeqqranen ifriqiyen. Yeǧǧa-d ala yiwet n tsekla: 28 n yedlisen n Magun, i d-yesra tasuqilt-nsen ɣer talatinit.
romeParas.1: Tawuri-agi tettwafka i tjmaɛt n yergazen yessnen tapunikt, yeṭṭef-itt-id Decimus Silanus. I Iṛumaniyen, win yesɛan tadamsa-s ɣef tmurt, tamusni-agi teqṛeb aṭas akken ad temmet akked temdint.
romeParas.2: Ulac aɣbalu apunik, ulac tasuqilt talatinit i d-yewweḏ ar assa: Magun ulac-it illa ala seg wawalen n yimeskaren igrikiyen d yiṛumaniyen.
plinyQuote: Mi tettwaṭṭef Qarṭaǧ, Usqamu-nneɣ yefka idlisen-is i yigelliden imeẓẓyanen n Tafrikt; yefka lameṛ ala ad ttusuqlen ɛecrin d tmanya n yedlisen n Magun ɣer talatinit.
plinyCite: Plin Amɣar, Amezruy n tɣawsiwin n ṭṭbiɛa, XVIII, 22
chrono.0.v: Magun yura 28 yedlisen-is s tpunikt. Azemz-is ur yettwassen ara s ṣṣeḥ: yettwasers tikwal ger useggas wis ṛebɛa d wis tlata uqbel Ɛisa, deg wagmuḍ n tfellaḥt taqarṭaǧit.
chrono.1.v: Aɣelluy n Qarṭaǧ. Usqamu yefka lameṛ n tsuqilt ɣer talatinit, yettwafka i tjmaɛt yeṭṭef-itt-id Decimus Silanus.
chrono.2.v: Kasyus Diyunizyus n Utika yesker-d tasuqilt tagrikit s 20 n yedlisen, yesseɣna-tt s yimeskaren igrikiyen.
chrono.3.v: Diyufan n Nise yekkes-d seg-s amezẓuy s 6 n yedlisen i ugellid Deyutarus n Galatya.
chrono.4.v: Varrun, deg udlis-is Ɣef tfellaḥt, isers Magun ɣer tazwara n yimeskaren n lɛulama.
chrono.5.v: Kulumel akked Plin Amɣar bedren-t aṭas: Kulumel yessawal-as « baba n tfellaḥt ».
booksTitle: Ayen i d-gellan deg 28 n yedlisen
booksLede: Adlis ummid ɣef tmazirt tameqqrant, yettwarna-d seg tkesritin i bedren yiṛumaniyen.
books.0.title: Ddwali & uzemmur
books.0.text: Afran n wakal, udem n yiṭij, asers, tukksi: ssas n ssɛaya n tfellaḥt tapunikt.
books.1.title: Isekla n tfakiyin
books.1.text: Irmman, luz, tiniren: lɣres, aḥraz d ukles n tfakiyin.
books.2.title: Izgaren, isirdan, tizizwa
books.2.text: Afran n lmal n lxedma, tasmegra, tirebbuɛt n tzizwa d ṣṣeḥḥa n lmal.
books.3.title: Tamazirt
books.3.text: Aseglem n lxedamen, tawuri n unabaḍ n tmazirt d llza n bab n tmazirt ɣef wakal-is.
precepts.0.v: « Win yuɣen tamurt, ilaq-as ad izenz axxam-is deg temdint, akken ur yesmenyaf ara yilluten n temdint ɣef wid n lexla. »
precepts.1.v: Zzu tibḥirin n ddwali s wudem ɣer ugafa, akken ad tent-ḥadren seg ssxana n Tafrikt.
precepts.2.v: Ferreq azemmur s lebɛid gar yiwen akked wayeḏ: 75 iḍaren deg wakal yelhan, 45 deg wakal iẖuban neɣ anida testeqsa waḏu.
precepts.3.v: Tarecfa n ccrab aẖelwi seg tẕurin iqquren ɣer yiṭij, i gettɛawad Kulumel awal ɣef wawal.
precepts.4.v: Fren izgaren ilemẓiyen, ddewciyen, iḍaren-nsen laẖluṭ, iqeṛwan ɣezzifen d uberkanen, lǧeb ameqqran.
kerkCap: Kerkwan, tamdint tapunikt n ẖali Bun, deg wul n tmura n tfellaḥt n Qarṭaǧ
legacy.0.title: Aɣbalu ameqqran
legacy.0.text: Varrun, Kulumel d Plin ssawalen-d seg Magun; seg-sen, tirrategin tipunikin kecment ɣer tfellaḥt taṛumit, sakin tagzirit.
legacy.1.title: Aɣrur n Ṛuma
legacy.1.text: Timura timeqqranin n Tafrikt taṛumit — yirden, zzit, ccrab — ssaẓalent tamusni i tewweḏ Qarṭaǧ ɣer tazwara-ines.
legacy.2.title: Isem yettwaselken
legacy.2.text: Qrib akk tirattal tipunikit ṣfant. Magun d yiwen seg kra n yimeskaren iqarṭaǧiyen i nessen isem-nsen d uẖric n uxeddim-nsen.

links.0.text: Azemmur, ddwali d yirden: tudrin n Qarṭaǧ.
links.1.title: Tadamsa tapunikt
links.1.text: Iswaq, lmɛadan d iberdan n lebḥer: ssɛaya n Qarṭaǧ.
